purpose: diagnostic pilot for sensitivity to perturbation sigma; not a replacement of the completed main experiment
selection_source: 10 instances (5+5) selected inside the exact definitive N=50 stability/consistency sample
selection: true labels, balanced, no prediction filter
paired_noise_across_sigma: same per-instance default_rng seed is reset for each sigma, so standardized Gaussian draws are paired across sigma values
perturbation: independent Gaussian noise per RGB component followed by clipping to [0,1]
